contract: GET /api/me/series/:id/readd-to-continue-listening removes only the selected series id from the caller's users.extraData.seriesHideFromContinueListening, answers 200 with the caller's browser user view, and emits user_updated to the caller only when the stored list changed; an unknown series answers 404.
exceptions: force is not applicable: this route has no force, hard or override mode

invariants.contract: Readding a hidden series removes only its id from the caller's stored list, answers 200 with the browser user view that GET /api/me returns afterwards, moves users.updatedAt forward and emits user_updated with that view to the caller's sockets only; a caller without a stored entry gets 200 and an empty list.
Readding when nothing is hidden answers 200 with an empty list, leaves users.extraData and updatedAt unchanged and emits no user_updated event.
Readding an unknown series answers 404 without changing the stored hidden list; without a valid token the route answers 401.
